## Overview

This guide walks through how to use Git and GitHub to collaborate on the same codebase using branches. This is designed for research assistants who may be new to Git.

The goal is simple:

- Everyone works on their own branch  
- No one breaks the main code  
- Changes are reviewed before merging  

---

## Step 1: Clone the Repository

Each person should download the repository to their local machine.

git clone https://github.com/jakederosa123/banich_lab.git
cd banich_lab
